description: Everything Flux: what is not ready, what it is reconciling, how long that takes, and how the controllers themselves are doing.

panels.title: Resources
panels.description: Flux custom resources kube-state-metrics currently sees.

panels.title: Not ready
panels.description: Resources whose Ready condition is not True. Anything above zero is worth opening.

panels.title: Suspended
panels.description: Resources with spec.suspend set. Flux ignores these entirely - they will never reconcile until resumed.

panels.title: Reconcile errors (1h)
panels.description: Reconcile attempts that returned an error in the last hour, across all Flux controllers.

panels.title: Controllers
panels.description: Flux controller pods reporting metrics. Expected: source, kustomize, helm, notification.

panels.title: API errors (5m)
panels.description: Kubernetes API responses to Flux that were not 2xx. Sustained 403/429 means RBAC or rate limiting.

panels.title: Not ready
panels.description: Every Flux resource that is not Ready, with the revision it is stuck on and the source it comes from.

panels.title: Not ready over time
panels.description: How long the current breakage has been going on, split by kind.

targets.expr: count by (customresource_kind) (gotk_resource_info{exported_namespace=~"$res_ns", customresource_kind=~"$kind", ready!="True"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reconcile ops/min
panels.description: Reconcile operations per minute per controller. Errors are drawn downwards so a failing controller is obvious.

panels.title: Reconcile duration by kind
panels.description: Median and p99 reconcile duration per resource kind.

panels.title: Slowest reconcilers (avg)
panels.description: Average reconcile duration per Kustomization and HelmRelease. A slow reconciler holds up everything that depends on it.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (kind, name) (rate(gotk_reconcile_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$ns", kind=~"Kustomization|HelmRelease"}[5m])) / sum by (kind, name) (rate(gotk_reconcile_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$ns", kind=~"Kustomization|HelmRelease"}[5m])))

panels.title: Slowest sources (avg)
panels.description: Average acquisition duration per source.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (kind, name) (rate(gotk_reconcile_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"$ns", kind=~"GitRepository|HelmRepository|OCIRepository|Bucket|HelmChart"}[5m])) / sum by (kind, name) (rate(gotk_reconcile_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"$ns", kind=~"GitRepository|HelmRepository|OCIRepository|Bucket|HelmChart"}[5m])))

panels.title: Reconcilers
panels.description: Every Kustomization and HelmRelease, with the revision Flux last applied.

panels.title: Sources
panels.description: Every source Flux pulls from, with its current revision and URL.

panels.title: Suspended
panels.description: Resources with spec.suspend set. Empty is the normal state; anything here is deliberately frozen and will not pick up git changes.

panels.title: Work queue depth
panels.description: Items waiting to be reconciled. A queue that does not drain means the controller cannot keep up.

panels.title: Active workers vs limit
panels.description: Workers busy against the configured concurrency limit. Sitting at the limit is the saturation signal.

panels.title: Longest running processor
panels.description: Age of the oldest in-flight reconcile per queue. Climbing without bound means something is wedged.

panels.title: Queue wait time (p99)
panels.description: How long an item sits in the queue before a worker picks it up.

panels.title: Retries/min
panels.description: Requeued items. Flux retries on failure, so a retry rate that tracks the error rate is expected.

panels.title: Unfinished work
panels.description: Work started but not completed. Non-zero and rising alongside a wedged processor.

panels.title: API requests by code
panels.description: What the Kubernetes API answers Flux. 429 means client-side rate limiting, 403 means RBAC.

panels.title: API requests by method
panels.description: Verb mix of Flux's calls to the Kubernetes API. The controllers do not export rest_client request duration, so this is the shape the client-go metrics give us.

panels.title: Events dispatched
panels.description: Events the notification controller forwarded to providers (Discord, Slack, ...), by response code.

panels.title: Event handling duration
panels.description: How long the notification controller takes to accept an event. No panel for Receivers: none are configured, so it would stay empty.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU per controller pod.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Go heap in use per controller pod.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: A goroutine count that only grows is a leak.

panels.title: Controller versions
panels.description: Image each Flux controller actually runs, straight from the pod spec.

panels.title: Leader election
panels.description: 1 while a pod holds the lease. Flapping here means the controllers keep losing leadership.

title: Flux
